note: Offline times are wall-clock on the recorded hardware (simulation on 16.0 CPU cores, training on the recorded model device); the reference sampler also needs the TOV grid once. Changing the prior, noise model or simulator requires re-simulation and retraining for the amortised model.

importance_corrected.note: IS-corrected posterior is asymptotically exact (same target as dynesty); its cost includes flow sampling, flow log-density and exact-likelihood evaluation.
